title: Event emission and indexed arguments
why: EVM logs use topics for indexed args; pallet-contracts re-encodes events. Topic hashing, indexed string/bytes (hashed on EVM) and event ordering across multiple emits can diverge.
hints: Events with 1, 2 and 3 indexed arguments (plus anonymous events if supported).
Indexed dynamic types (string/bytes) — hashed into the topic on EVM.
Multiple events emitted in one transaction, including duplicates.
